records.rationale: _convertV4 has one constructor-fixed ledger recipient, never an operator/user-selected address. convert admits only that ledger and enabled live operating state under nonReentrant. It pulls exact selected source rights, spends only the exact approved amount, enforces captured native-ETH quote/caller minimum and exact output, then verifies native/source prefunds remain unchanged after payment. Current royalty original-currency claims do not instantiate this converter.

convert intentionally captures wrappedBefore before exact pull/router. The v3 result must increase wrapper balance by exactly returned output and leave source prefund unchanged; after unwrap wrapper must return to wrappedBefore and native must increase by exact output. The function is nonReentrant/ledger-only/lifecycle-guarded. Stronger of independent wrapper and native-ETH quote floors now applies, with live reviewed wrapper decimals18 before/after. Actual nonstandard dependency behavior still needs qualification.

_convertV4 executes only through convert nonReentrant/ledger-only/live/operating. sourceBefore intentionally proves exact complete source spend, including after native ledger callback; nativeBefore brackets exact output and final payment. Fixed executor validates reviewed route and exact approved amount; caller/native oracle floor and deadline remain. A prior raw source or ETH prefund cannot subsidize returned output.

convert sourceBefore is an intentional exact-delta snapshot. ExactToken.pull takes exactly amount from immutable ledger, exact router allowance is reset, and source balance must return to pre-pull value. NonReentrant and fixed route/source/hash checks reject cross-function writes; wrapper/native payout floors, exact received output and lifecycle postchecks remain independent.

During unwrap nativeSender admits only configured wrapper, not an arbitrary ETH callback source. convert is nonReentrant and _checkWrapper validates pinned/proxy policy plus decimals18 before/after. Exact wrapper return to wrappedBefore and native increase==output preserve all prefunds; final output must exceed stronger captured native/wrapper/caller floor. A broken/upgradeable wrapper is still a qualification/liveness risk, not universally guaranteed safe.

The ledger callback in _convertV4 receives only measured native output at constructor-fixed address. Both converter and real Rewards entrypoint are nonReentrant; final checks require source balance==sourceBefore and native balance==nativeBefore after payout. Any rejecting callback or unmatched token movement rolls back complete conversion/rights debit.

Individually reassessed unchanged executor close context after Slither changed only presentation order of the two nativeReceived=0 descendants. close is fixed Manager-only/current Access binding/sealed/nonReentrant; validates main+aux Vault ownership/pool, sends exact actual ETH/ZZZ receipts only to fixed Vault, then deletes association/count after both burns succeed. receive admits only temporarily expected PoolManager. Intermediate views confer no write authority; compromised core/periphery qualification remains required. Checker normalization was not broadened.

Individually reassessed unchanged executor collect context after presentation-only reordering of nativeReceived reset descendants. It is fixed Manager-only/sealed/nonReentrant, validates both owned LP IDs and collects each with zero-liquidity decrease. Temporary expected native sender and exact counter/balance proof isolate each leg, actual receipts go only to fixed Vault, mappings/liquidity remain. A callback cannot invoke another typed writer. No claim of safety against arbitrary compromised dependencies.

RoutePolicy p intentionally starts all-zero and is read only inside source!=wrapper branch after loading routes[routeId], route enabled/source identity and reviewed router/factory/pool validation. Direct exact unwrap uses no p fields and requires zero route ID. v4 dispatch returns before this local. No undefined memory value reaches execution.

nativeSender=v4Executor is a tightly scoped receive gate around fixed executor.execute; reset to zero immediately afterward. convert outer nonReentrant/lifecycle guards prevent callback economic reentry; exact output/source/native balances and post-ledger checks detect unexpected ETH/token changes. Setting/resetting a receive gate around its required callback is intentional.

nativeSender resets after reviewed wrapper.withdraw under convert nonReentrant. Only that temporary wrapper may send ETH; exact wrapper debit/native credit and postwithdraw proxy/code/decimals18 validation precede payment. Router callbacks occur while sender is zero; intermediate state cannot authorize another conversion or governance write in this contract.

nativeSender is assigned configured wrapper only AFTER exact v3 output/floors and route checks succeed, then used solely for one withdraw. convert is ledger-only/nonReentrant/live/operating; resetting after withdraw plus exact final balance checks prevents a persistent arbitrary-ETH receiver mode. No generic recipient/executor is introduced.

convert deliberately separates native-v4, direct exact unwrap and reviewed-v3-to-wrapper branches. v3 captures both wrapper/native ETH quotes, ceil-applies governed loss to their stronger expected output, retains caller floor, exact balances/approvals and before/after wrapper/code/proxy/decimals checks. Complexity reflects distinct trust boundaries; reducing the metric must not drop a guard. Real feeds/routes/wrapper/gas and independent approval remain open.

Native v4 output is intentionally sent by low-level call only to immutable ledger. Success plus final unchanged native/source prefunds are verified under nonReentrant; rejecting ledger reverts whole conversion. There is no rescue recipient, governance-selected payout or arbitrary calldata.

v3/unwrap output uses a deliberate native call to immutable ledger under nonReentrant and exact final nativeBefore proof. Source/wrapper balances and stronger captured native/wrapper/caller floors are independently enforced. Failed ledger receiver causes atomic rollback; optional wrapper is not used by native-v4 branch.
